criteria.requirement: Add actual required_if rule with schema-validated {field, equals}. Evaluate conditions at the real required-fields phase after normalization, even when the constrained field is absent; support existing sibling/dotted/root lookup, False/None conditions and defaulted discriminator fields. Reuse required/ignore_none_values/nullable semantics for presence, respect update=True and excludes handling, preserve type/ordinary dependencies behavior and report missing fields through native required errors.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
